findings.evidence: Exposed and Reference have crowded overlapping rings at full view and 96 dpi. Supplied audit has 36 overlapping-circle pairs, 37 spacing violations and 37 fallback rows per candidate. A .1183 pt minimum center distance is much less than the 3.45 pt outer ring diameter.
findings.requirement: Actual mark spacing must support an honest raw-observation layer at fixed 9 pt2, not just source-to-artist retention.
findings.action: Increase categorical packing allowance with verified group-boundary clearance, retaining data/quantitative axes/font/point area. Reinspect actual marks after numerical spacing passes; passing packing alone does not resolve summary intersections. Do not alter KDE bandwidth, numeric values or sample sizes to mimic a desired silhouette.

findings.evidence: Centered hollow points compete with KDE contours and colored IQR rectangles; numerous rings cross contour lines and some ring portions are hidden or interrupted by the summary layer. The white-body candidate does not cleanly separate these layers; merely tinting/widening candidate02 is insufficient.
findings.requirement: Estimated density, raw observations and quartile summary must be distinguishable; hollow marks do not automatically ensure that.
findings.action: Arrange a physically viable category-associated side lane plus narrower KDE contour, or otherwise reserve an actual separate summary position. Verify contour-to-mark and median/IQR visibility on the final image; no data/test/scale changes.
